slides.text:
**Rida F'kih took an iOS Safari web app from 60 to 120 FPS.**

It works without a settings flag, using the scroll compositor and OffscreenCanvas.

By default, Safari holds animation frames and touch events to 60 Hz on a 120 Hz screen.

Four steps from the write-up.

Apple keeps the web at 60 Hz to save battery, one developer pointed out.

**Which step would you try first? Save this.**
bullets: Read input from an invisible scroller the compositor moves.
Poll scrollTop via MessageChannel, locked to vsync: 80 reads/s.
Add an empty rAF loop (90/s), then a tiny scroller for 120 Hz.
Draw via transferControlToOffscreen to skip the 60 Hz pass.
